correctness.rationale: For all n>=2 and any positive link exposures the exact nilpotent exponential reduces the periodic linearization to a product of elementary shears. Eigenvector bookkeeping before each outgoing contact gives (lambda-1)v_(i+1)=a_i lambda^[incoming-earlier]v_i. Closing around the cycle proves the spectral root relation; constructing eigenvectors and using a generic-simple-root limit proves equality with the characteristic polynomial for all parameters. Primitivity gives simple Perron multiplier. A strictly increasing H_k establishes each sharp threshold and order ranking. Exact rational bounds give the three-group reversal; the mean generator is Hurwitz since log(2)>2/3. Independently replayed 152 permutation polynomials with Fraction arithmetic for 2<=n<=5. Finite replay supplements, not replaces, the infinite proof. At equality only a simple unit multiplier is asserted.

value.rationale: The chronology-independent arithmetic average can predict decay although exact forward seasonal time-ordering predicts exponential invasion. The theorem supplies sharp, complete, all-n exposure thresholds indexed by a simple statistic, proves the minimum three-group dimension at which this direction reversal is possible, and gives a purely rational exact counterexample. This is a motivated structural boundary for temporal-contact epidemic inference, not a renaming of a known constant-rate threshold or an arbitrary finite census. Limits are one-edge-per-season, equal recovery, local invasion only.
